title: Agent goals — persistent objectives the agent works toward each run
description: Every agent in the framework declares a set of long-running goals (typically 3-7) that its periodic runs incrementally advance. Goals stick around forever; the dashboard renders a per-agent goals tab showing which are accomplished and current progress on the rest. Each run computes new metric values + appends to progress_history.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id (e.g. goal-cap-broken-pages-zero). Never reused.

description.description: Why this goal matters + how reaching it would manifest.

metric.description: How progress is measured. Optional but strongly encouraged.

factor.description: Reaching the target raises it to ceil(value × factor), or lowers it to floor(value ÷ factor) for a decrease goal, and keeps the goal active instead of accomplishing it. A ratchet also re-opens the goal if it falls back. Use it on north-star counts that should never 'finish' and drop out of the prompts (framework/core/goals.py apply_measurement).

ratchet.description: Optional. A ratcheted target survives routine re-seeds (see seed_target). A seed that sets a different target replaces it.

reopen.description: Re-open an accomplished goal when a later measurement falls back past the target (direction-aware). Unset: storage config/goals-config.json reopen_on_regression (by_agent_id.<id>, then the top-level value) decides; it defaults to false.

seed_target.description: Bookkeeping on ratcheting goals: the target the last seed asked for. A re-seed with the same target keeps the ratcheted metric.target. Written by init_goals, never by hand.

reopened_at.description: When the goal last went from accomplished back to active (a measurement fell back past the target, or a seed re-armed it).

reopened_reason.description: Why it was re-opened, in one line.

ratchet_history.description: The last 20 ratchet steps, oldest first: each is a target the goal reached, and the new target set in its place.

annotations.description: Dated notes pinned to the goal's series, e.g. 'measurement correction: Safari-17 fleet removed', so a step change in the value is not read as a regression. init_goals merges a seed's annotations by (ts, note) and never drops existing ones; the last 50 are kept.

value.description: The corrected value the note refers to, if any.

run_ts.description: The run that produced this measurement.

progress_history.description: Append-only — every run pushes a new entry. Drives the goals chart.

directives.description: What the agent should do each run to advance this goal. Plain-text — read by the agent's LLM at run start to bias its analysis.
